REGULATION (EU) No 596/2014 on market abuse

(1) A fixture recital about market integrity.

Article 7

Inside information

1. For the purposes of this Regulation, inside information shall comprise:

(b) in relation to commodity derivatives, fixture text on commodity derivatives.

Article 16

Prevention and detection of market abuse

1. Fixture text on arrangements to detect suspicious orders and transactions.

2. Fixture text: any person professionally arranging or executing transactions shall report suspicious orders and transactions without delay.

Article 17

Public disclosure of inside information

1. Fixture text: an issuer shall inform the public as soon as possible of inside information.

4. Fixture text: an issuer may delay disclosure to the public of inside information under conditions, and shall inform the competent authority immediately after the information is disclosed.

Article 18

Insider lists

1. Fixture text on drawing up a list of all persons who have access to inside information.
